artworks.title: The Emperor Aulus Vitellius
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash heightened with white over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length figure of a standing man. He is shown with one leg bent and the other extended, with his left hand across his chest and his right hand holding a scroll. The man has a rounded face with a prominent chin, high forehead, short curly hair, and wears a flowing garment. The background features a stone-like architectural frame with columns or decorative elements and an inscription in the top right corner that reads, "A-VITELLIVS. GERMAN. IMP. AVG.P.M.TR."

artworks.title: A Striding Youth with His Arms Raised, Seen from Behind
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a human figure seen from the back, spanning from head to feet. The person is in a dynamic pose with one arm raised and bent at the elbow, and the other arm extended downward. The facial features are not detailed, with the head shown in profile from behind. The figure's hair is loosely suggested, and there are no clothing details, accessories, or objects present. The background is plain, emphasizing the figure's linework.

artworks.title: Cristi... v'la-t-y un boeuf qui est bien fait!...
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals standing closely together, facing the right. In the foreground, there are five men wearing top hats, with distinct facial features and various expressions. They are dressed in suits and coats typical of the era. Behind them is a woman with a scarf covering her head and a shawl over a patterned dress. The background features framed pictures, creating depth in the setting, suggesting an art gallery or exhibition space.

artworks.title: Horseman and Vagabond in the Forest (Le Cavalier en forêt et le piéton)
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with a path leading through dense foliage. The horizon is obscured, creating depth. The foliage is etched with intricate details, suggesting trees. The path is lined with sketch-like brushstrokes. The color palette is monochromatic in dark gray and off-white tones. Two figures and a horse are subtly included, blending into the landscape. The scene appears complex with movement and shadows.

artworks.title: Château de Pont-Gibaud
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic village scene with old buildings, a castle on the horizon, a elevated view with architectural and landscape details depicted through intricate brushstrokes. The color palette is predominantly gray, with a monochromatic theme. A patch of water, vegetation, buildings, and a castle in the distance can be seen, under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with light brown wash over red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows several abstracted figures in different poses. Two seated figures on the left, with one holding an ambiguous object. Three standing figures on the right, depicted in an abstract manner. The lines are fluid and expressive, using red and dark ink to define shapes and shadows.

artworks.title: Louis de France, duc de Bourgogne
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a person within an ornate oval frame. The person has long, curly hair and a composed facial expression. They are wearing a suit of armor with intricate detailing, and there is a plumed helmet in the foreground. A fabric sash is draped across their chest. A rich, flowing fabric is below the helmet. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Auguste-Jean-Marie Guénepin
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of the upper half of a person in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to the right. The individual has distinct facial features, such as a broad face with defined cheekbones and a slight smile. They have curly, voluminous hair framing their face and are dressed in a buttoned-up garment with a high collar, reminiscent of historical clerical or academic attire. The person is holding a book with both hands in front of them, suggesting a sense of contemplation or study. In the background, there is an architectural element resembling a classical building facade, possibly indicating an outdoor or city setting. The drawing is done in pencil, giving it a detailed and precise appearance.

artworks.title: L'ane et le chien (The Donkey and the Dog)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: The image shows a donkey with baskets, a dog interacting with it, a person resting, a stone bridge over a river, buildings, mountains, and cloudy sky in a serene, pastoral scene. The artwork features detailed brushwork and etching-like textures with muted earth tones and pastel colors.

artworks.title: Les deux rats, le renard et l'oeuf (Two Rats, the Fox, and the Egg)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene with a stone structure, a forest, and animals. The image shows a natural landscape with a stone monument or fountain on the left, surrounded by trees. In the center, two rats are carrying an egg, and a fox is standing on the right. The illustration features detailed cross-hatching and line work depicting textures in the stones, foliage, and animal fur.

artworks.title: La chauve-souris, le buisson et le canard (The Bat, the Bush, and the Duck)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with a duck on sandy ground, a tree on the left, and a flying bat in the sky. The sky is dynamic and the ocean waves are visible.

artworks.title: Le chat et le rat (The Cat and the Rat)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: This is a painting of a forest scene with animals. The image features a cat caught in a large net between two tree trunks, struggling to free itself. A rat is observed on a tree trunk above the cat. Other animals, such as an owl on a branch, are also situated within the forest. The painting is in the style of Jean-Baptiste Oudry, highlighting the tension between the serene landscape and the drama of the animals' interaction.

artworks.title: Le corbeau, la gazelle, la tortue et le rat (The Crow, the Gazelle, the Tortoise, and
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: The image shows a grounded perspective of a natural landscape. The horizon is high in the composition, leading the eye toward the sky. A tree dominates the left side, with detailed bark and green leaves. The colors are realistic, with browns, greens, and yellows for grass and hills. Animals are present, including a turtle and another creature in the foreground, with a gazelle in the middle ground and a crow in the sky. The scene conveys motion and stillness in a peaceful setting.

artworks.title: Les poissons et le cormoran (The Fish and theCormorant)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a cormorant catching a fish in the water. Trees, buildings with red-tiled roofs, an arched stone bridge, and distant towers are also visible. The colors are mainly green, brown, red, and pastel tones.

artworks.title: Les vautours et les pigeons (Vultures and Pigeons)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: The image shows birds in flight and on the ground. The scene includes trees, hills, an old building with a red-tiled roof, and greenery. The brushstrokes are detailed, emphasizing texture. The color palette is earthy with browns, greens, and blues. Closest to the viewer are an eagle and a downed pigeon, with more pigeons nearby. In the distance, more birds are in flight. The overall effect is one of tension and motion within a calm setting.

artworks.title: Le corbeau, la gazelle, la tortue et le rat (The Crow, the Gazelle, the Tortoise, andthe Rat)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gazelle trapped in a net in a forest setting. The scene shows a gazelle caught in a net tied between trees, with a raven perched on a branch above. On the ground, a rat is gnawing at the net, seemingly trying to free the gazelle. The drawing portrays a forest setting with tall trees and lush foliage, creating a natural and serene environment. The detailed strokes and shading contribute to a lifelike representation of the animals and the forest setting.

artworks.title: Le loup et le chasseur (The Wolf and the Hunter)
artworks.artist: A.-J. de Fehrt after Jean-Baptiste Oudry
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: The image shows a wolf holding an arrow in its mouth, standing upright near a hunter and a wild boar. Three deer are hanging from a tree on the left. The landscape features trees, a cloudy sky, and a bird flying. The colors consist of earthy tones, greens, browns, reddish hues, grays, blues, and white.

artworks.title: L'homme qui court apres la fortune et l'hommequi l'attend dans son lit (The Man who  Courts Fortune and the Man Who Sleeps in Bed)
artworks.artist: A.-J. de Fehrt after Jean-Baptiste Oudry
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures in a scene. One figure is a man with mid-length, wavy light brown hair, wearing a red coat and green knee-length trousers. He carries a walking stick in his right hand and raises a hat with his left hand. A knapsack is slung over his back. The second figure is a partially clothed woman with long, flowing blonde hair, sitting on a stone ledge next to a large wheel. She is partially wrapped in a yellow cloth, and her left arm rests on the wheel. In the background, an older figure is visible through a nearby window. The setting appears to be the exterior of a stone building with textured walls, a shuttered window, and an arched doorway.

artworks.title: Le lion (The Lion)
artworks.artist: A.-J. de Fehrt after Jean-Baptiste Oudry
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a lion in a forested rocky landscape. The lion is seen standing over a defeated animal. In the background, a forest with dense trees frames the scene. One monkey is visible among the rocks watching the lion. The setting conveys a wild, rugged terrain with rocky formations and scattered vegetation. Light and shadow emphasize textures in the lion's mane and the surrounding rocks. The composition focuses on the lion and its prey.

artworks.title: Le torrent et la riviere (The Torrent and theRiver)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a red coat in a river, holding on to a horse. A hat floats nearby. Three figures in 18th-century clothing stand on a rocky riverbank looking concerned. In the background, there are trees, a castle-like structure, and large clouds. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing movement and textures. The color palette includes muted tones like earthy browns, greens, soft blue, and subtle reds.

artworks.title: Le loup et le chien maigre (The Wolf and the Thin Dog)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with a wolf on the left and a dog on the right. In the background, there is a water mill, a building with smoke coming out of its chimney, a wooden bridge over a river, and a faint line of hills or trees in the distance. The sky has delicate hues of blue and pale yellow. The artwork has fine and delicate brushstrokes, featuring earthy browns, greens, and muted reds.

artworks.title: Le roi, le milan, et le chasseur (The King, the Kite, and the Hunter)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a royal court scene. The scene shows a grand hall with a high ceiling and columns, featuring a lavish throne adorned with red fabric. A king wearing a crown is seated on the throne, being approached by another figure. A large bird is perched on another person's arm, while other figures, potentially soldiers or courtiers, are present around the scene, wearing helmets and carrying spears. The composition and style highlight the grandeur and drama of the court.

artworks.title: La lionne et l'ours (The Lion and the Bear)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: The illustration features a lioness and a bear on a green patch of land. The lioness is on the left and the bear is seated on the right, facing each other. In the background, there are green trees against a light sky. The scene is detailed with brushstrokes showing texture on the animals and trees. The colors used are earthy greens and browns for the landscape and animals, with a muted blue for the sky.

artworks.title: Le thesauriseur et la singe (The Miser and the Monkey)
artworks.artist: Pierre Francois Martenasie after Jean-Baptiste Oudry
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: The image shows a man kneeling next to the door of a stone building. He gazes at the door, adjusting it with one hand. He has curly hair and a defined beard, wearing a yellow tunic and a draped purple garment. A monkey sits on the window ledge at the top left, holding a golden object. In the background, there is a green plant, water, and a cloudy sky.
